review_notes: The audience hook preserves the existing query calls, open enablement, organization-to-program dependency, and ACTIVE filtering.
The form remains the sole owner of sources; the audience hook receives sources read-only and delegates all writes through onSourcesChange.
Duplicate and empty-source errors remain at the existing form error boundary through onSourcesError, while transient source selection/search state is local to the hook.
No JSX, mutation, API-client contract call, cache-key change, locale-provider change, or backend change was introduced.
Protected concurrent-agent hashes and the Phase 01 Create Exam scope hashes remain unchanged.
